title: AI Kit: personal settings (~/.ai-kit/overrides.json)
description: Applied on top of the organization defaults (organization.json): lists add up, objects combine, a single value is replaced. Run update after a change. Keys starting with _ are explanations.

extra_skills.description: Skills to add, by catalog name (docs/skills-reference.md).

disabled_skills.description: Skills to remove, by catalog name.

extra_commands.description: Kit commands to add, for example handoff, research, ask.

extra_agents.description: Review agents to add, by name without the ai-kit- prefix.

hooks.description: Guardrails: true turns one on, false turns it off. protected-paths is on by default.

mcp.description: MCP servers by name. organization.json describes them; a profile lists those it activates; in overrides.json, true or false turns a server on or off for you, and {"server": {...}} adds your own. See docs/mcp.md.

oneOf.description: true: turn on a server defined by the organization; false: turn off a server your profile activates.

enabled.description: organization.json: true = active for every profile. overrides.json: false = defined but off.

server.description: How the CLIs start the server: a single transport (command, url or httpUrl).

command.description: Executable that starts a local server.

headers.description: HTTP headers of a remote server.

trust.description: Automatic trust is refused by the kit.

oneOf.description: A server: {"server": {...}}. In organization.json, active for the profiles that list it, or for everyone with "enabled": true. In overrides.json, active unless "enabled": false.

models.description: Model per agent capability; without it, agents use the main model.

frictions.description: On a friction signal: propose /friction (default), log it automatically, or say nothing.

code_assist.description: Gemini Code Assist licence: its Google Cloud project. Not with vertex.

vertex.description: Gemini through Vertex AI: project and region. Not with code_assist.

model.description: Main model imposed on the CLI, for example gemini-2.5-flash.
